title: Your Phone Can See Your TV Remote's Light
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: Your phone can see a light your eyes cannot.
Point your TV remote at the camera and press a button.
The tip lights up. That's infrared light, just past red.
Your eyes fade out at red. The camera's sensor keeps going.
No glow? Try the selfie camera. Rear cameras often filter infrared out.
But most TV remotes have been glowing at you all along.
